heading: Medical and dental care
lead: The Secretary may provide medical and dental care, including care in private facilities, for personnel of the Administration entitled to that care by law or regulation.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 857–3(b) of this title prior to repeal by Pub. L. 107–372.
